title: HEADLAMP & W/S WIPER ACCESS DOOR SWITCH MOUNTING & VACUUM HARNESS
summary: Under-dash vacuum controls for the pop-up headlamps and the windshield wiper door: the headlamp vacuum valve (at the light switch, View B) is screwed with a plain washer to the instrument panel support, and the wiper door control valve and switch sit under the LH instrument panel pad with a tag. A vacuum hose harness (stripe-coded: yellow, light blue, white, red) runs behind the gauges to the check valve, vacuum switch and valves. View A: the instrument panel cover is screwed to a bracket on the panel pad.
